Text:

POWER: Gain 4 stages. Destroy the top 3 cards of a player's Life Deck. The first Styled Setup destroyed by this effect is placed into play under your control.

name: Bardock - Oozaru
Text:
POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. 
If stopped, draw a card. 
DAMAGE: 3 stages.

name: Bardock - True Saiyan
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Whenever a player searches your opponent's Life Deck, you may raise your anger 1 level. 
POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck. Your opponent reveals their hand. Search your opponent's LIfe Deck for a card and destroy it.

name: Bardock - True Saiyan
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Whenever a player searches your opponent's Life Deck, you may raise your anger 1 level. 
POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck. Your opponent reveals their hand. Search your opponent's LIfe Deck for a card and destroy it.

name: Bardock - Vengeful
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your opponent lays with their hand revealed. Whenever an effect destroys cards from your opponent's Life Deck, you may raise your anger 1 level. 
POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck to banish the bottom card of your opponent's discard pile. You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, your opponent discards a card from their hand.

name: Bardock - Vengeful
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your opponent lays with their hand revealed. Whenever an effect destroys cards from your opponent's Life Deck, you may raise your anger 1 level. 
POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck to banish the bottom card of your opponent's discard pile. You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, your opponent discards a card from their hand.

name: Bardock's Premonition
Text:
POWER: Reveal the top 4 cards of your Life deck. Your opponent separates those cards into 2 piles. Place one pile into your hand and the other on top of your Life Deck in any order. Destroy the top 2 cards of your Life Deck. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Bardock's Riot Javelin
Text:
(Limit 2 per deck.) 
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 1 stage. Search your opponent's Life Deck for a non-Named attack and destroy it. You may perform a copy of that attack for your next action this combat. 
DAMAGE 3 life cards. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Black Energized Guard
Text:
(If you have destroyed or banished cards from a player's Life Deck this combat, you may play this card to stop an energy attack instead.) 
[DEFENSE]: Stop a physical attack. 
Raise or lower a player's anger 1 level. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Black Interrogation
Text:
POWER: Discard a card at random from your opponent's hand. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Black Punt
Text:
(Villains only. You may only have one "Black Punt" attached.) 
[ATTACK] Physical attack costing 1 stage. 
Attach to your MP. While attached, your attacks are considered Styled. Banish this card when your opponent's MP advances a level. 
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.

name: Black Rupture Drill
Text:
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck, you may place it into play.) 
[CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 life card of damage. At the beginning of your turn, banish the top 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile.

name: Black Trick Shot
Text:
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 2 stages. 
Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. Until the start of your next turn, after a player gains anger, lower that player's anger 1 level. Damage from this attack cannot be prevented or modified. 
DAMAGE: 4 life cards. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Blue Combative Stance
Text:
(If this card is discarded from your hand during combat, your next attack this combat is considered a copied attack.) 
[DEFENSE] POWER: Prevent 3 life cards and 3 stages of damage from an attack.

name: Blue Getaway
Text:
[DEFENSE]: Prevent all damage from an energy attack. 
If you use a Styled Setup in your next action, your oponent skips their next action this combat.

name: Blue Recuperating Drill
Text:
[INSTANT] POWER: Use when entering combat. Raise or lower a player's anger 1 level. 
POWER: Discard a card from your hand to perform a copy of the last attack your opponent used this combat.

name: Blue Seeking Blast
Text:
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 2 stages. 
Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. 
DAMAGE: 4 life cards. HIT Search your life deck for a Styled Drill and play it. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Blue Zinger
Text:
[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If you have prevented damage this comat from a non-Endurance source, this attack deals +5 life cards of damage. 
DAMAGE: 5 stages.

name: Chilled - Cackling Tyrant
Text:
(If your MP is Frieza, Cooler or King Cold, you may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.) 
[CONSTANT]: Cards cannot attack to personalities. 
POWER: Rejuvenate 1. Banish the bottom 3 cards of your opponent's discard pile.

name: Chilled - Familiar Foe
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal their life card damage as stages of damage instead. 
[INSTANT] POWER: Use after your attack deals 5 or more stages of damage. That attack is considered to deal critical damage. Raise your anger 2 levels. 
POWER: Rejuvenate 1. You may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.

name: Chilled - Pissed
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal their life card damage as stages of damage instead. Your attacks that deal 5 or more stages of damage are considered to deal critical damage. Whenever you deal critical damage, you may raise your anger 1 level. 
POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. 
DAMAGE: 6 stages. 
HIT: Raise your anger 1 level. Rejuvenate 2. Banish an opponent's Setup, Drill or Ally.

name: Chilled - Prophet
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal their life card damage as stages of damage instead. Your attacks that deal 5 or more stages of damage are considered to deal critical damage. Personalities cannot be more than 5 stages above 0. 
POWER: Gain 3 stages. Choose a personality in play. That personality loses 3 stages.

name: Chilled - Space Pirate
Text:
[CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal their life card damage as stages of damage instead. Your attacks deal +1 stage of damage. 
POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. 
Rejuvenate 1. This attack is considered to deal critical damage. 
DAMAGE: 5 stages. HIT: Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Chilled's Enraged Volley
Text:
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 1 stage. 
Raise your anger 1 level. Whenever your opponent's MP changes levels this combat, set their power level to 0. Whenever you use a critical damage effect this combat, choose a personality in play. That personality loses 1 stage. 
DAMAGE: 5 stages. HIT: This attack stays in play to be used a second time this combat. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Chilled's Prescience
Text:
(After performing a successful attack, you may discard this card from your hand to draw a card. If you do, that attack is considered to deal critical damage.) 
POWER: Rejuvenate 3. Choose a personality in play. That personality loses 3 stages.

name: I'll Dig Your Grave!
Text:
(You cannot win by MPPV if you advance a personality level with this card.)
[ATTACK] Physical attack.
Damage from your attacks cannot be prevented this combat.
DAMAGE: 6 stages. HIT: You may advance your MP 1 level. If you do, advance your opponent's MP 1 level.

name: Kami - Earths Guardian
Text:
[CONSTANT]: After an Earth Dragon Ball enters play, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. 
POWER: [ATTACK] Energy attack costing 1 stage. 
You may shuffle an Earth Dragon Ball in play back into its owner's Life Deck to search your LIfe Deck for a Styled Drill and play it. 
DAMAGE: 3 life cards. HIT: raise your anger 1 level or Rejuvenate 1.

name: Kami - Fighting Spirit
Text:
(When you advance to this level, you may shuffle a Dragon Ball in play back into its owner's Life Deck. Search your Banished Zone for an Earth Dragon Ball and place it into play.) 
[CONSTANT]: When you control 3 or more Earth Dragon Balls, your opponent's attacks deal -3 stages of damage and your energy attacks deal +3 life cards of damage. 
POWER: Raise your anger 1 level. You may banish an Earth Dragon ball you control. If you do, search your Banished Zone for a Dragon Ball or Styled Drill and Rejuvenate it.

name: Kami - Overseer
Text:
(When you reach this level, cature an Earth Dragon Ball or place a Dragon Ball from your Banished Zone into play.) 
POWER: [ATTACK] Energy attack costing 1 stage. 
If 5 or more Earth Dragon Balls are in play and/or in your Banished Zone, search your discard pile for a Styled Drill and play it and this attack cannot be stopped. 
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.

name: Kami - Prepared
Text:
(Your Drills are not discarded when advancing or lowering from this level.) 
POWER: [ATTACK] Energy attack costing 1 stage. 
Capture an Earth Dragon Ball or choose a card in your discard pile and Rejuvenate it. 
DAMAGE: 3 life cards. HIT: If you control 3 or more Earth Dragon Balls, search your LIfe Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play.

name: Kami's Focused Beams
Text:
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 2 stages. 
Choose a damage modifier in play. It is doubled for this attack. Search your Life Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play. 
DAMAGE: 2 life cards. HIT: You may choose a non-personality/non-Mastery card you control in play. If you do, your opponent gains control of it and choose a card in your discard pile and Rejuvenate it. 
(Banish after use.)

name: Kami's Guardian Drill
Text:
(This card is considered Styled.) 
[CONSTANT]: At the beginning of each player's turn, destroy the top X cards of that player's Life Deck. X = the number of Earth Dragon Balls the owner of this Drill owns in play. 
POWER: Choose a card in your discard pile and Rejuvenate it. If you control 3 or more Earth Dragon Balls, you may choose 2 instead.

name: King Vegeta - Ruler
Text:
(If your MP is a Saiyan, you may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.) 
[DEFENSE] POWER: Prevent all damage from a physical attack. If your MP is Vegeta, you may use this Power a second time this combat.

name: Krillin's Kamehameha
Text:
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 2 stages. 
Raise your anger 1 level. You may destroy the top card of your Life Deck to destroy an opponent's Setup or Drill. This attack does +X stages of damage. X = the number of stages your opponent's MP is above 0. 
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.

name: Master Roshi's Kamehameha
Text:
[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 2 stages. 
This attack can only be stoped by an Energy Combat card. Shuffle a non-MP/non-Mastery card not attached to your MP in play back into its owner's Life Deck. 
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.

name: Namekian Force Push

[ATTACK] Energy attack costing 2 stages. 
This attack can only be stoped by an Energy Combat card. This attack deals +X life cards of damage. X = the number of Earth Dragon Balls you own in play. 
DAMAGE: 5 life cards. 
HIT: Banish the top or bottom 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile.

name: Namekian Heroic Drill

[CONSTANT]: If a Dragon Ball is destroyed from your opponent's Life Deck, you may place it into play under your control instead of your opponent placing it on the bottom of their Life Deck. 
INSTANT POWER: Use when you Rejuvenate. Banish that many cards from the top of your opponent's discard pile instead of Rejuvenating.

name: Namekian Justice Punch

[ATTACK] Physical attack. 
This attack can only be stoped by a Physical Combat cards. 
DAMAGE: 5 stages. 
HIT: Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

(Villains only. Limit 1 per deck.)

(Banish after use.)

name: Namekian Reinforced Glow
Text: POWER: Destroy the top X cards of your opponent's Life Deck. X = the number of Earth Dragon Balls you control.

Raise your anger 1 level. 
DAMAGE: AT +2 stages. HIT: Destroy a Drill.

(Banish after use.)

POWER: Rejuvenate this Drill to perform a non-Styled physical attack dealing 3 stages of damage.

name: Vegeta - The Crown Prince
